regressions.details: Independent probes covered JSON optional round trips, direct registered union structure and unstructure hooks, exact underlying-type delivery, scalar Annotated, list Annotated, and a nested optional inside an Annotated list. The only broad-suite failure was reproduced unchanged on pristine pre-fix source.

explainability.details: Annotated dispatch selects a handler using the underlying origin, but the unadapted handler was later invoked with the outer Annotated alias. The adapter consistently supplies the same origin used for dispatch, preventing the optional-union handler from indexing the wrong type arguments.

prReadiness.details: The implementation is a localized dispatch adapter with focused optional, round-trip, and registered-hook tests. It applies cleanly, exactly matches the frozen tree, and passes acceptance, practical regression, build, formatting, compilation, and changed-line lint checks.
